input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research/buildbot-sheathing milestone 32: backlash sign flips under a balance controller's ground reaction (friction cones at the sole contact points)

errors.what: The first friction-cone solve at the stud pose was infeasible: the upright poses of milestones 30-31 cannot balance a 50 N press through real soles
errors.fix: added a lean (com_dx by secant) so the centre of pressure sits mid-sole at 37.5 N; reported as a finding and as a departure from the plan

errors.what: QP held joints exactly at tau_f, so float rounding marked them loose
errors.fix: 1e-6 N m slack in the hold constraint; rerun

errors.what: Launched a second run.py while one was still writing the same results.txt
errors.fix: killed both, reran once cleanly before using any number

doc_friction.issue: pkill hook: a bracketed pattern still blocks if the same path appears elsewhere in the command line (e.g. a following rerun of the script); split into separate calls
wait_for.py's --marker usage on a results file that a script truncates and rewrites is easy to misread: a timed-out wait plus a relaunch caused two writers on one file

deviations.why: The registered plan used milestone 31's upright poses, which the cones cannot balance at 25-50 N above 0.8 m
deviations.did: leaned every pose into the wall and evaluated H118-H120 there; disclosed in LOG, README and paper
deviations.result: all 36 poses balance; hypotheses evaluated on physically balanced poses

deviations.why: The registered 'hold' controller was infeasible everywhere, leaving H120 untestable
deviations.did: added a post-hoc 'hold-min' controller (hip rolls, hip yaws, ankle rolls) and a calibration-pose search, both labelled not registered
deviations.result: feasible everywhere; worst per-pose loss 3.74 pts, one calibration still 1.1-1.4 mm

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a robotics PhD student implementing contact-force QPs over MuJoCo models, the lean search, rerunning a 36-pose study and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
